entries.title: Galatians 5:1
segments: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ has made us free, and do not again be held with the yoke of bondage.

entries.title: Galatians 5:2
segments: Behold, I, Paul, say to you that if you are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

entries.title: Galatians 5:3
segments: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do all the Law,

entries.title: Galatians 5:4
segments: you who are justified by Law are deprived of all effect from Christ; you fell from grace.

entries.title: Galatians 5:5
segments: For we through [the] Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness out of faith.

entries.title: Galatians 5:6
segments: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any strength, but faith working through love.

entries.title: Galatians 5:7
segments: You were running well. Who hindered you [that] you do not obey the truth?

entries.title: Galatians 5:8
segments: [This] persuasion [is] not from Him who calls you.

entries.title: Galatians 5:9
segments: A little leaven leavens all the lump.

entries.title: Galatians 5:10
segments: I have confidence in you in the Lord, that you will think nothing else, but that he troubling you shall bear the judgment, whoever he may be.

entries.title: Galatians 5:11
segments: And I, brothers, if I yet proclaim circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the offense of the Cross has ceased.

entries.title: Galatians 5:12
segments: I wish that those causing you to doubt will cut themselves off.

entries.title: Galatians 5:13
segments: For, brothers, you were called to liberty. Only do not [use] the liberty for [an] opening to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

entries.title: Galatians 5:14
segments: For all the Law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

entries.title: Galatians 5:15
segments: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you are not consumed by one another.

entries.title: Galatians 5:16
segments: I say, then, Walk in [the] Spirit and you shall not fulfill [the] lusts of [the] flesh.

entries.title: Galatians 5:17
segments: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. And these are contrary to one another; lest whatever you may will, these things you do.

entries.title: Galatians 5:18
segments: But if you are led by [the] Spirit, you are not under law.

entries.title: Galatians 5:19
segments: Now the works of the flesh are clearly revealed, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lustfulness,

entries.title: Galatians 5:20
segments: idolatry, sorcery, hatreds, fightings, jealousies, angers, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

entries.title: Galatians 5:21
segments: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revelings, and things like these; of which I tell you before, as I also said before, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Galatians 5:22
segments: But the fruit of the Spirit is: love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith,

entries.title: Galatians 5:23
segments: meekness, self-control; against such things there is no law.

entries.title: Galatians 5:24
segments: But those belonging to Christ have crucified the flesh with [its] passions and lusts.

entries.title: Galatians 5:25
segments: If we live in [the] Spirit, let us also walk in [the] Spirit.

entries.title: Galatians 5:26
segments: Let us not become glory-seeking, provoking one another, envying one another.
